glossZh: （英式）地方性公交，慢车；地方线路
glossEn: public transport consisting of a bus or train that stops at all stations or stops
note: public transport consisting of a bus or train that stops at all stations。英式英语特有（take the local）。现有中文无此义项，属新增。

glossZh: 当地的，地方性的；本地的
glossEn: relating to or applicable to or concerned with the administration of a city or town or district rather than a larger area
note: relating to or concerned with the administration of a locality。**最常用义**。线索：local people / the local government / a local resident。

glossEn: of or belonging to or characteristic of a particular locality or neighborhood
note: of or belonging to or characteristic of a particular location。强调「某地特有」。线索：local customs / local produce。

glossEn: affecting only a restricted part or area of the body
note: affecting only a restricted part or area of the body。医学义。线索：a local anaesthetic / local infection。**注意：表达「局部而非全局」英语更常用 partial / local rather than systemic，不是 local 单字。**
